newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Quake shakes large area of Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Quake shakes large area of Colombia.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.8 on the Richter scale shook a large area of northern and central Colombia on Sunday afternoon but there were no immediate reports of damage, the authorities said.

The epicenter of the quake, which struck at 1:17 p.m. local time (1817 GMT), was near the town of Villanueva in northeast Santander province, but it was felt in the capital Bogota and elsewhere around the country, experts at the National Seismology Institute said.

The tremor came five hours after another earthquake measuring 4.9 on the Richter scale shook oil-rich, eastern Casanare province. There were no reports of damage after that quake which was centered in a jungle region, a spokesman for the National Seismology Institute said.
Casanare is home to extensive oil operaitons run by British Petroleum Co Plc. Company officials were not available for comment on the earthquake.
